_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
description: pages:choice/39, pages:condi/15 and fx_text/16/48 are type-0x11 filler records in JP retail; an earlier layer re-encoded their bytes as glyphs. The two visible records are translated from the US record; fx_text/16/48 gets the US record's own bytes back.
evidence: the three records' bytes in the US and JP ROMs and in the base image; the builder counts every pages family and fx_text leaf for filler re-encoded as glyphs
